items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: He did the Foster and Beatty. That was a duo.

ctx.x: Well, he had a way of being light on his feet, you see, because he looked to be the size of about, I'd say a little over 300 pounds. And he was very tall, see. And he had a what do you call it -- such shiny cheeks, see. He was very versatile, see. He done blackface comedian. He did the Foster and Beatty. That was a duo. In other words, he acquired a partner. He took Jonah's place. Used to be Jonah
and Foster. But he was famous before then, you see. But he was one of the Hoofer's Club's members, you see.
Were they known mostly for their dancing, or was their act a mixture of tricks, walks, jokes, things like that? Were they really a top dancing --
